verdict.rationale: Customer.io's official MCP server lets an AI tool "work with segments" through natural-language prompts, and the CLI gives agents full workspace access, framed as letting the AI do anything you can do in the UI. The in-app "Describe segment" agent separately shows that turning a plain-text description into a segment is a built-in capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that segment creation from a description works through the MCP/CLI programmatic surface (not just the in-app button), a documented example or tool reference for segment creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
